name: lookup_sales_lead_with_employees
description: Look up a sales lead record with its parent employees data joined. The id argument is the exact opaque primary key, not a human name, title, external code, or numeric code suffix. When only a business handle is known, resolve it with query_sales_leads and pass the returned id; when the exact id is already known, call this tool directly.
